harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified SSH ed25519 public key, locked its password, and enforced key-based SSH authentication cluster-wide via /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf (PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes). Verified functionally before and after a full node reboot: pubkey login succeeds, password login is rejected outright with no prompt. Completed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence protocol (boot_id and uptime_since changed, services and opsadmin config recovered intact).
actions_performed: Checked baseline: opsadmin did not exist, sshd defaults were commented out (cmd-bdebc510151c40f0)
Created opsadmin user with home and .ssh dir (cmd-fee234018dc34f57)
Installed the required public key into /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys with correct ownership/perms (cmd-bc4cc5c41547444f)
Locked opsadmin's password (cmd-c24ad8fb2d544ea9, verified via cmd-572c3e530ee14804)
Wrote /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no (cmd-2e90ada5ba9f495d)
Validated sshd config syntax and effective settings via sshd -t and sshd -T (cmd-d4432d61598b471b)
Reloaded sshd to apply config (cmd-7042d748d8784f24)

Functionally verified pubkey login success and password login rejection using a temporary test keypair, then restored authorized_keys to only the required key (cmd-adc33a7f6ac64c24, cmd-5fff3cc57c9e4e22)
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id, uptime, sshd active, sshd -T settings, opsadmin/authorized_keys state (cmd-2b08219bdd544256)
Issued reboot via 'shutdown -r now' backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect (cmd-dadb749d16a74cd5)
Confirmed node was down mid-reboot (cmd-3e7f6c372d3a4ba9), then confirmed exec availability restored (cmd-adc9dcecc4b848b0)
Captured post-restart boot_id/uptime showing change, plus sshd active/config, opsadmin user, authorized_keys, and locked shadow entry all recovered (cmd-6f4a456e7f334016)
Ran a final post-reboot end-to-end SSH functional test: pubkey login succeeds, password login rejected, and restored authorized_keys to only the required key (cmd-109d0304a3fc4bf0)

evidence.requirement: opsadmin user exists on node1 with the specified public key installed for SSH access
evidence.summary: opsadmin did not exist at baseline; created and populated authorized_keys with exactly the required ed25519 key, confirmed present pre- and post-reboot

evidence.requirement: SSH key-based authentication is required (password/keyboard-interactive disabled)
evidence.summary: Deployed sshd_config.d override disabling PasswordAuthentication/KbdInteractiveAuthentication, validated with sshd -t/-T, reloaded, and proved functionally: pubkey login succeeded, password login was rejected with no prompt

evidence.requirement: node1 restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 8c28f3cd..., uptime_since 08:03:00, sshd active, key-only settings active, opsadmin/authorized_keys correct prior to reboot
Reboot command acknowledged before disconnect; subsequent probe timed out confirming the node was actually restarting

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Exec access restored; boot_id changed to d3c1ba32... and uptime_since advanced to 08:03:59, proving an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: sshd active with key-only settings intact, opsadmin user/locked password/authorized_keys intact after reboot; live SSH test confirmed pubkey login works and password login is still rejected post-reboot
